info.title: Tracker API
info.description: Contract: design/API.md. One workspace per PLATFORM_PROJECT_ID. The bearer is the signed-in user's token or an Access Key assertion (audience tracker; scope tracker:read for GET, tracker:write otherwise). External-subject assertions resolve by immutable registered agent handle. GET scopes tracker:read; other methods tracker:write; missing scope is 403 insufficient_scope. Every key is refused on Admin routes. See /agent-guide for the collaboration protocol.

patch.description: Authorization: any authenticated user. Every changed field emits one Activity. Changing to bug requires a report; changing away clears it. Parent cycles are invalid. Under review an agent cannot set a completed status.

get.description: Requires the Tracker bearer and forwards it to the internal Directory binding. Accepts only PNG, JPEG or WebP, 1 byte to 512 KiB. Redirects are refused; transport reads are bounded to 4 MiB. Never accepts an upstream URL.
